response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong software craftsmanship, design skills, and mentoring ability, he falls significantly short of critical minimum qualifications. Most notably, he has only ~6 months of C++ experience versus the required 8 years, and lacks deep focused experience building large-scale infrastructure and distributed systems. His career has emphasized polyglot full-stack development across diverse technologies rather than the specialized cloud compute platform expertise this role demands.
strengths: Strong software engineering fundamentals with proven expertise in testing, TDD, CI/CD, and architectural patterns
Demonstrated ability to design and launch complex systems including founding GISCollective and maintaining high-impact applications
Excellent mentoring and knowledge-sharing track record through workshops, talks, and teaching initiatives
concerns: Critical gap in C++ programming experience (only ~6 months vs. 8-year minimum requirement)
Limited focused experience in large-scale distributed systems and cloud infrastructure despite some exposure at Dunnhumby
Recent entry into formal technical leadership (Staff role since April 2025) without demonstrated 2+ years mentoring cloud or DevOps engineers
